name: MTEB English v2 retrieval metric scope
description: Available named v2 benchmark, pinned to the inspected implementation for its retrieval metric capability. Active means published availability, not reproduced quality or continuing maintenance. This is a source-only capability proposal. No evaluation, dataset admission, model/data permission, price quote or deployment gate is established. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.
